page.layout: One page of running text, one column, no marginal notes. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: quippe cum nec à ficco putrefieri quicquam fit aptum, nec à frigido: sic carnes & reliqua, quaecunq; alioqui ab hominibus solent, hæc sale, alia muria, alia aceto, vel alio quopiam, q; siccat, commodè præparantur: deprehendes & Borea vento natura frigido & ficco omnia quæ diutissimè impustria[?] durare, contra putrescere facilimè ven. o austrino, qui calidus & humidus est. Itaque nos in totum contra quam illi statuunt calidum & humidum esse ver, decernim[?], cum neq; tale sit, neq; si esset, utiq; salubre esset. Hac Galenus. Cū igitur promtissimè putrescant corpora calida & humida, teste eodem Gal. 1. de diff. febr. c.3. & quidem celerius in locis calidis & humidis, quam frigidis & siccis, ut demonstratum est, sequitur calidam humidamq; aeris ambientis constitutionem atque temperiem esse cæteris pejorem. Corpora autem calidiora humidioraque putredinis noxam (nisi difflentur & refrigerentur) citius contrahere, quam frigidiora & siccio̊ra, oftendunt febres humorales. Omnis h. humor alienus à natura corporis, in quo continetur, neque aptus ad eius nutritionem necessariò putrescit, febremq; accendit, putrescit autem celerrimè, cum locus, in quo fuerit collectus, est calidus: id quod ventriculus manifestat plus iusto calidior, nullus enim cibus immodicè calfactus, sine putredine in eo permanere potest, corrumpi n. cibum ob immoderatam caliditatem, & humidi defe-

page.notes: The page begins mid-sentence ("quippe cum"), a continuation from the previous page. Printed "Hac Galenus" and "teste eodem Gal. 1. de diff. febr. c.3." are in italic. The final word of the last line ("defe-") is hyphenated and continues on the next page. Doubtful readings: "impustria" (possibly a printing error), "decernim" (the printed superscript is unclear), and "siccio̊ra" (the printed word is probably "sicciora"). The catchword at the foot is partly illegible. The signature "B" is shown as printed.
